findings.summary: The earlier session's commit d75877e changed socboard/smoke.py, outside the issue's Files list, to add retry_after to Answer; it is additive and left for the maintainer to accept or replace.
This session wrote the OTLP side before posting its claim comment, so the claim was recorded after the work began; the claim comment says so.
The probe's tests ran in the sandbox on Python 3.11 against a throwaway install of the SDK, not on the project's Python 3.12 environment, so CI is the only run on the real one.
